# Customer Success Audit

## Purpose
Assess the state of the Customer Success department in the whole system: how well the customer lifecycle, health scores, churn prevention, and support hold together, and where they are weak.

## Scope
- Customer lifecycle and onboarding
- Health scores and at-risk accounts
- Churn prevention and service recovery
- Complaint resolution
- Support triage and issue ownership

## What is in place
- [ ] Lead agent for support and post-launch triage is named and active
- [ ] Health score that can be recalculated from its inputs
- [ ] Plan for every at-risk account, with signals and actions
- [ ] Triage where every issue has an owner and a first response
- [ ] Record of accounts, health, and resolutions in one place

## Gaps
- [ ] At-risk accounts with no signal and no plan
- [ ] Health scores that cannot be recalculated
- [ ] Issues with no owner or no first response
- [ ] Complaints resolved without a recorded cause
- [ ] Customer knowledge living in scattered notes

## Next steps
- Pick the highest priority gap and name its owner
- Add or fix the missing agent, skill, command, or workflow for that gap
- Run the new piece on a real at-risk account or support issue and check the result against evidence
- Record the decision and the outcome in the decision log
- Repeat for the next gap
- Share the finished audit and the changes with the people who need them, so the work reaches distribution
